acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce under recorded load (BASE vs fixed counts) or refute with counts.
If reproduced: the detached-browser start wait no longer fails under CI/host contention without weakening the escaped-descendant retirement assertion; one mutation shows the test still bites.
body: suspected: Observed 2026-10-15 on PR #933 (head ebc2525ad), CI job 116669413001 go-product-shard (5), linux runner: internal/testrunner TestExecuteRetiresEscapedDetachedDescendants/timeout-graceful failed at execute_unix_test.go:609 'detached browser never started' after 9.42s. PR #933 does not touch internal/testrunner. Expected: the fixture's detached child starts before the wait expires. Actual: start wait expired. Second linux observation 2026-10-16 on PR #927 (head 863b57297, does not touch internal/testrunner), CI job 116734196584 go-product-shard (5): the /normal subtest failed at execute_unix_test.go:609 'detached browser never started' after only 1.61s, while timeout, timeout-graceful and interrupt passed. Hypothesis (unverified): in normal mode the command exits quickly and the start wait is bounded by the run, so the test races the detached child's start marker. Darwin: 10/10 loaded passes in PR #942's lane, so linux-only so far.
title: suspected: testrunner TestExecuteRetiresEscapedDetachedDescendants/timeout-graceful flakes in CI
